zh.title: 中國商飛C919高原型客機在上海成功完成首飛
zh.summary: 中國商用飛機有限責任公司（COMAC）研製的C919高原型客機（C919-600）於2026年7月29日在上海浦東國際機場（PVG）成功完成首飛，首飛歷時1小時59分鐘。該機型由中國商飛與西藏航空聯合開發，機身較標準版縮短約6個隔框，規劃載客量為140至160人，專為高高原機場營運設計。
body: 中國商用飛機有限責任公司（COMAC）研製的C919高原型客機於2026年7月29日成功完成首次試飛。該架註冊號為B-002U、型號為C919-600的試飛樣機，於上海浦東國際機場（PVG）起飛，在完成全部預定試飛科目後安全降落，整個飛行過程歷時1小時59分鐘。
該款高原型客機由中國商飛與西藏航空聯合開發，其機身設計較C919標準版縮短了約6個隔框，規劃載客量為140至160人。根據中國民航相關規定，海拔在2,438公尺（8,000英呎）或以上的機場即歸類為高高原機場，該機型正是為滿足此類高海拔區域的營運需求而進行了專門的系統功能優化與機身修改。

en.title: COMAC's High-Altitude C919 Variant Completes Maiden Flight
en.summary: China's COMAC has completed the maiden test flight of its new C919 high-altitude (plateau) variant in Shanghai. On July 29, 2026, the prototype, registered as B-002U (C919-600), took off from Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG) and performed all scheduled maneuvers during a flight lasting one hour and 59 minutes. Jointly developed by COMAC and Tibet Airlines, this high-altitude variant features a shortened fuselage that is approximately six frames shorter than the standard version. It is designed to accommodate between 140 and 160 passengers and operates in high-altitude regions, which Chinese regulations define as airports at elevations of 2,438 meters or higher.
body: On July 29, 2026, the Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC) successfully completed the maiden test flight of its new C919 high-altitude variant. Departing from Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG), the prototype, registered as B-002U and designated as the C919-600, flew for one hour and 59 minutes, completing all scheduled test flight maneuvers.

Jointly developed by COMAC and Tibet Airlines, the C919-600 features a fuselage that is approximately six frames shorter than the standard C919 model. Designed for high-altitude operations, the aircraft has a passenger capacity of 140 to 160 seats. Under Chinese regulations, airports at elevations of 2,438 meters (8,000 feet) or higher are classified as high-altitude airports.

zh.title: 以色列空軍重新啟用第193中隊 換裝新型海鷹直升機
zh.summary: 以色列空軍於2026年7月28日在帕爾馬希姆空軍基地舉行儀式，正式重新啟用第193中隊。該中隊曾於2025年8月因舊型AS565豹式直升機退役而關閉，此次重啟換裝了新型西科斯基SH-60F海鷹海上直升機，目前已有三架運抵以色列，年底前預計再接收兩架。
body: 以色列空軍於2026年7月28日在帕爾馬希姆空軍基地舉行儀式，正式重新啟用第193中隊。該中隊將負責操作新型的西科斯基SH-60F海鷹海上直升機（希伯來語稱為「Shalach」），以執行支援海軍及擴大海上作戰應對等任務。
第193中隊原於1987年成立，曾操作「Atalef」AS565豹式直升機，並在該機型於2025年8月退役後關閉。目前已有三架海鷹直升機運抵以色列，年底前預計將再交付兩架。其中兩架正於國防公司進行作戰整合。

en.title: Israeli Air Force Reactivates Squadron 193 with New Seahawk Helicopters
en.summary: The Israeli Air Force has reactivated Squadron 193 at Palmachim Airbase on July 28, 2026, following the arrival of new Sikorsky SH-60F Seahawk maritime helicopters, known in Hebrew as Shalach. The squadron had been shut down in August 2025 after the retirement of its AS565 Panther helicopters, leaving the Navy without a dedicated maritime helicopter. Three Seahawks have arrived in Israel so far, with two more expected by the end of the year. Currently, two of the arrived helicopters are undergoing operational integration at Israeli defense companies.
body: The Israeli Air Force reactivated Squadron 193 during a ceremony held at Palmachim Airbase on July 28, 2026. The squadron will operate the new Sikorsky SH-60F Seahawk maritime helicopters, designated "Shalach" in Hebrew, to support the Israeli Navy and expand maritime operational capabilities.

Squadron 193 had been closed in August 2025 following the retirement of its AS565 Panther ("Atalef") helicopters. Three Seahawk helicopters have arrived in Israel so far, with two more expected by the end of the year. Two of the current aircraft are undergoing operational integration at local defense companies before flight testing and entry into service.
